title: Partial desingularization up to normal-crossings in characteristic 0 and 2
summary: We address the question of normal-crossings-preserving resolution of singularities (NC-preserving resolution), and compare the cases of characteristic 0 and characteristic 2. In characteristic 0, it is shown by Belotto da Silva and Bierstone arxiv:2602.09114 and Włodarczyk arxiv:2602.14266 that, if one allows to introduce stack theoretic weighted blowups, any variety over a field of characteristic 0 admits a normal crossings resolution.
